repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Docker Hub repository to check, e.g. "postgres" or "node" for an official image, or "bitnami/postgresql" for a namespaced one. If no namespace is given, "library/" (official images) is assumed.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Only return tags whose last_updated timestamp falls within this many days.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of tags to return.
